snippet.title: Tower King: Defense
snippet.description:
👑 The King has returned… and this time, he’s fighting alongside you!
Build powerful towers, cast epic spells, and control a mighty hero in Tower King — a next-level tower defense game where every decision matters.

🔥 Features:
Action-packed tower defense battles
Real-time hero control and powerful royal abilities
Dozens of unique towers and deadly enemies
Strategic upgrades, rare loot, and boss fights
Epic progression across a vast fantasy world

💥 Defend your kingdom from undead hordes, monstrous bosses, and dark magic. Are you ready to take the throne?
🛡️ Play now and become the legendary defender your kingdom needs!
📲 Available soon on Google Play and App Store
👉 Don’t forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more updates, gameplay, and developer insights!
